يستلفتوا (form X)
# يَسْتَلْفِتُوا (yastalfitū) /jas.tal.fi.tuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلْفَتَ (istalfata)
# يُسْتَلْفَتُوا (yustalfatū) /jus.tal.fa.tuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلْفَتَ (istalfata)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
